bookingOpens: Online for 1 to 4 people; for 5 or more, phone or email info@houseoftides.co.uk. The phone line is open 10am to 5pm, Thursday to Sunday.
cancellation: A £50 deposit a person is taken when booking and comes off the bill. It is refunded if the booking is cancelled more than 72 hours ahead; later cancellations, no-shows and reductions in party size lose it.
walkIns: Walk-ins are welcome but not guaranteed a table; the bar menu is served in the ground-floor bar.
waitlist: If a date is full, add your name to the waiting list in the online booking system and the restaurant will call if a table comes free.
groups: Tables of 5 or more are booked by phone or email. The whole restaurant can be hired privately (info@houseoftides.co.uk).
dressCode: Relaxed, with no strict dress code, but no shorts, sleeveless T-shirts, hats, flip-flops or Sunderland football shirts.
children: No infants or babies; best suited to children over 10. There is no children's menu, and everyone pays the same menu price.
